risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (232.6) indicates extreme market fear, and earnings in 57 days present binary event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Oversold oscillators (RSI 32.8, Stoch K 14.57) combined with supertrend bullish and ichimoku above cloud provide structural setup for mean reversion bounce, especially with price near support at 42.63.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 232.6), lack of price confirmation below moving averages, negative MACD, absent volume support, zero fundamental catalysts, and binary earnings risk in 57 days create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
